value.rationale: The first nontrivial canonical global sign quotient of a doubled six-cross-polytope acquires fifteen independent integral two-torsion classes although its free double cover is a wedge of spheres and has torsion-free integral homology. The exact ranks and torsion multiplicity answer a natural symmetry-quotient question left unresolved by ordinary and equivariant inflation formulas. A direct torsion obstruction in a motivated geometric quotient has independent value without an all-dimension formula.
